findings.F1: In the choppy calm profile, the swing-scaled 14-day move is graded against the next 7 days' unusual move more strongly than elsewhere, with a Spearman rho of 0.24 on 151 grid cases against 0.07 on 994 cases outside the profile. The large-rise bins are tiny, though: 19 cases on 13 days at +3.9 % (t 1.04) and 6 cases on only 2 days above 2 usual moves. The tested idea's grading is there in folds B and C, but its situation is too rare to measure.
findings.F2: The book is not limited by its size per case but by how rare it is. The total move per case is 11.5 times the 0.22 % cost, yet the book is in a position on only 2 % of coin-days and makes 0.0046 trades a day. Its gain also rests on a few trades: in folds B and C, 3 XRP trades sum to +90.4 % of the +201 % summed over all 48 trades, while XMR's 5 sum to −22.1 %.
findings.F3: Across all profiles, swing-scaled 14-day rises of 1 to 2 usual moves are followed by +4.1 % unusual 7-day moves (134 cases, 62 days, t 2.13). Rises above 2 usual moves give only +2.2 % (t 0.58), and the overall rho is 0.086 on 1145 cases. This is a weak, general 14-day continuation of the kind the 79 every-profile long strategies and the breakout and nearness-to-high books already hold.
findings.F4: Outside the choppy calm profile, a day falling 1 to 2 of its usual daily swings is followed by a +1.10 % unusual next day (701 cases, 264 days, clustered t 2.54). The same follow-through is positive in each year 2018 to 2021 (+0.7 %, +0.1 %, +1.5 %, +1.7 %). This is the next-day rebound after falls that the map's 16 falling-agitated long strategies already hold.
findings.F5: Inside the choppy calm profile, a day rising more than 2 usual swings is followed by −1.46 % unusual the next day (39 cases, 32 days, t −2.13) and by −3.2 % over 3 days (12 cases, 11 days, t −3.04). Outside the profile the same up days are followed by +0.25 % (t 0.45). With about 60 cells examined and the 3-day reading on 11 days, this does not stand out from chance.
findings.F6: Weekday effects do not hold up when the cases of one day are taken together. Over all bars no weekday's next-day unusual return reaches |t| 1.5 (the largest is Saturday, +0.37 %, t 1.44). Inside the profile, Thursday (−0.95 %, t −2.47) and Sunday (−1.05 %, t −2.11) are isolated cells among 14 examined.

no_ideas: The patterns that are measured with enough cases (F3, F4) repeat effects the profile map already holds. The ones specific to choppy calm (F1's large rises, F5's fade of large up days, F6's weekdays) rest on 2 to 32 days at t near 2 after about 60 cells were examined, so none stands out from chance enough to found an idea.
